text.p: Global mining house CRA-RTZ said on Tuesday it had appointed Gary Pemberton and Raymond Seitz as non-executive directors.
The Anglo-Australian company also said Lord Alexander and Sir Denys Henderson would retire as directors on December 31.

Pemberton is chairman of Qantas Airways Ltd and the former managing director of transport group Brambles Industries Ltd. Seitz was U.S. Ambassador to the United Kingdom from 1991 to 1994 and is vice-chairman of Lehman Brothers International (Europe) and a director of other companies including British Airways Plc.

CRA-RTZ said the board changes follow the retirement of non-executive director Bill Dix in September and the previously-announced retirement of non-executive chairman Sir Derek Birkin on December 31 this year.
Birkin will be succeeded by Robert Wilson as executive chairman.
